hi-def.definition:
A polite way of greeting a hearing impaired individual.
> "Look, there comes old Mrs. Danielson.  The poor thing just can't hear anything anymore.  Hi-Def!"
> "That filthy old man has been sitting on the street for so long that his darn ears have done rotted plumb off.  Hi-Def!"
> "Hey that's Pete Townsend over there, isn't it?  Hi-Def!"

hi-fi.definition: n. equipment for the reproduction of sound with high fidelity
hi-fi.translation:
n. 高保真度
a. 高保真度的

hi-fis.definition:
n. equipment for the reproduction of sound with high fidelity
n. the reproduction of sound with little or no distortion
hi-fis.translation: n. 高度保真（性）( hi-fi的复数形式 ); 高度保真的音响装置

hi-jackings.translation: (hi-jacking 的复数) n. 劫持（hijack的现在分词）

hi-lite.translation: 图像最亮部分; 高亮度

hi-lites.translation: (hi-lite 的复数)  图像最亮部分; 高亮度

hi-lo.translation: abbr. high-low 高-低光（汽车头灯的）

hi-tech.definition: a resembling or making use of highly advanced technology or devices
